integrity: Direct finite enumeration and a separate partial-permutation completion lemma support a fully analytic all-size proof; exact finite verification is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations, ordinary one-line consecutive triples, finite-sample first cross moments only; no higher moments or arbitrary nonuniform laws. Historical priority subject to older non-indexed enumerative results.
title: Positional sign laws for cycles and consecutive triple patterns in uniform permutations
